Alex / Samira —

Adding a few specifics from the infra/playbook perspective so your network team can start the config: 

Network & egress notes:
- VPC endpoint: create an interface endpoint pointed at redwood-us-west-2.ingress.rew (we will supply exact endpoint DNS when we open the peering).
- IP allowlist: we support both CIDR and DNS (FQDN) allowlisting. If you must use FQDN for POC that's OK; for production we still recommend CIDR-based allowlist for deterministic routing.
- NAT / Egress: if you use dynamic NAT your egress will come from a small set of elastic IPs; please load the attached veloxai-network-allowlist.xlsx with the EIPs once allocated.
- DNS: ensure outbound DNS resolution to our peering endpoint; split-horizon is okay but make sure our endpoint resolves to the private IPs post-peering.
- mTLS: Redwood accepts client certs signed by your CA. For cert rotation we support either: (a) you push rotated cert + new trust chain to us via the support portal, or (b) use ACME/managed rotation if you prefer (we can set that up in Dedicated/Private plans).

SDK & Auth snippets (see attached sdk-auth-snippets.txt):
- For POC with API keys: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> header + x-rw-project-id
- For mTLS we require TLS client auth during the TLS handshake and a secondary JWT short-lived token in the Authorization header (this is used for RBAC). Example:
  curl --cert client.pem --key client.key https://private.ingress.redwood.example/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJ...'

Structured output / tool-calling:
- Max payload: 512KB response body; recommend issuing tool calls asynchronously for >30s ops.
- Schema: top-level object {"instructions":..., "tools": [{"name":..., "input":{...}, "callback": "https://..."}], "safety": {...}}
- Timeouts: default 15s for sync tool calls; you can request extended timeouts in the workshop for long-running rerank jobs.

Embeddings & reranker notes:
- Embedding batch throughput: in POC expect ~2000 vectors/minute on a small cluster. For production we size based on index QPS; we recommend an initial index shard with 100M vectors upper bound for the first phase.
- Reranker latency: head-of-pipeline reranks add ~40-120ms depending on model; we can configure a fast approximate reranker for low-latency paths and a high-accuracy reranker for fallback.

Next steps (action owners):
- VeloxAI: upload allowlist + confirm network lead (Alex) — owner: Alex (ETA: 11/24)
- Redwood: provide final endpoint DNS + peering instructions and open engineering workspace — owner: Ben (ETA: 11/24 COB)
- Schedule 60-min workshop (networking + SDK) — owner: Karthik (we'll propose Wed/Thu next week)
